name: archmage
description: Required reading for the grimoire: teaches the agent how to use grimoire plugins and how to bind new books.

interface.shortDescription: Required reading for the grimoire plugins
interface.longDescription: Archmage is the meta plugin of the grimoire. It injects a short guide on how to use installed grimoire plugins at session start and ships the skill that scaffolds, validates and releases a new book-of-* plugin.
defaultPrompt: Which grimoire books are installed and what do they cover?
Bind a new book called book-of-engineering.
